taskmaster-pro.title: TaskMaster Pro
taskmaster-pro.description: Fullstack task manager with professional architecture and a focus on real teams.

problem.description: Many product teams manage work with tools that don't fit their real flow, causing operational friction, lost visibility, and scalability issues as the team grows.
painPoints: Inflexible roles and permissions that don't reflect the real team structure.
Information overload that hinders adoption by non-technical profiles.
Lack of clear visibility into the real status of work and bottlenecks.
Difficulty scaling projects and teams without losing control or traceability.
Dependency on multiple tools to cover basic needs (tasks, communication, tracking).

solution.description: I designed and developed a SaaS fullstack platform that centralizes task, team, and project management, prioritizing clean architecture and a fluid user experience.

features.title: Kanban Board
features.description: Intuitive task visualization with drag-and-drop functionality.

features.title: Internationalization (i18n)
features.description: Full support for Spanish and English, with automatic language detection.

features.title: Project Management
features.description: Organize your tasks into different projects for better tracking.

features.title: Team Management
features.description: Collaborate with other users within specific projects.

features.title: Notification System
features.description: Stay up to date with updates on your tasks and mentions.

features.title: Secure Authentication
features.description: JWT-based login and registration with route protection.

features.title: Search and Filtering
features.description: Quickly locate tasks by title, status, or priority.

features.title: Automatic Task Priority Classification
features.description: Auto-management of task priority (low, medium, high) can be enabled in settings based on the configured time margin.

features.title: Premium Design
features.description: Modern, responsive interface with fluid animations (Framer Motion).

challenges.title: Kanban State Management
challenges.description: Maintaining task order consistency after multiple drag-and-drop moves and syncing with the DB.

challenges.title: Board Performance
challenges.description: Efficient rendering of hundreds of tasks using virtualization and selective memoization.

reserva-saas.title: SaaS Booking Platform
reserva-saas.description: Online booking system with integrated payments for professionals and small service businesses.

problem.description: Many service professionals (classes, consultations, creative sessions) manage their bookings manually via WhatsApp, email, or unsynchronized calendars, creating errors, wasted time, and missed appointments.
painPoints: Lack of upfront payments or deposits.
Generic tools poorly adapted to their real workflow.

solution.description: I designed and developed a SaaS platform that centralizes the management of bookings, clients, and payments in a single system, allowing professionals to automate their schedule and reduce operational friction.

features.title: Authentication and Access Control
features.description: Flexible and secure authentication system supporting multiple access methods and clearly separating Admin, Provider, and Client roles.
details: Login with Google OAuth, Email/Password, and Magic Links.
OTP verification for email registrations.
RBAC with differentiated portals.
Active abuse protections: rate limiting, CAPTCHA, and honeypots.

features.title: Advanced Booking Engine
features.description: Configurable booking engine allowing professionals to define services, availability, and complex rules without friction for the end client.
details: Flexible services: duration, price, capacity (1-on-1 or groups).
Hybrid availability with weekly rules and date exceptions.
Automatic buffers between appointments to avoid overlaps.
Concurrency management per service and global limits.

features.title: Google Calendar Sync
features.description: Two-way synchronization with Google Calendar to avoid double bookings and keep the schedule always updated.
details: Automatic import of external events.
Real-time blocking of busy times.
Automatic update upon cancellations or rescheduling.

features.title: Integrated Payments and Monetization
features.description: Complete payment system with Stripe allowing upfront charges, automatic payouts, and a scalable SaaS model.
details: Upfront payments to confirm bookings.
Stripe Connect Express for direct provider payouts.
Support for platform fees per transaction.
Monthly or annual subscription plans for providers.

features.title: Recurring Bookings Management
features.description: Native support for periodic bookings, ideal for classes, therapies, and continuous services.
details: Weekly or monthly configuration.
Automatic generation of future sessions.
Centralized management of cancellations and changes.

features.title: Internationalization (i18n)
features.description: Platform ready for international audiences with full multi-language support.
details: Interface fully translated to English and Spanish.
Automatic language detection via middleware.
Localized emails and error messages.

features.title: Automation and Notifications
features.description: Automation system reducing manual tasks and keeping clients and providers informed.
details: Automatic reminders 24h and 1h before the appointment.
Transactional emails for confirmations and cancellations.
Serverless cron jobs.

features.title: Analytics and Dashboard
features.description: Interactive dashboard for providers to understand their business performance.
details: Revenue and booking volume metrics.
Most popular services.
Clear visualizations using interactive charts.

challenges.title: Handling Webhook Idempotency
challenges.description: Ensuring Stripe webhooks are processed exactly once. Network retries could cause duplicate records if not handled correctly.

fivem-store.title: FiveM Store
fivem-store.description: Premium marketplace for the FiveM community: buy and download scripts, assets, and resources for your server.

problem.description: The FiveM community lacks a centralized, trustworthy platform for acquiring premium server resources. Content creators have no professional channel to monetize their work, and server administrators must search scattered forums, risking malicious or outdated downloads.
painPoints: No reliable, secure marketplace specifically built for FiveM.
No protection for digital content: files could be freely redistributed.
Lack of real-time support to resolve purchase or installation questions.
Manual inventory and order management with no centralized admin panel.

solution.description: I designed and developed a full-featured e-commerce platform for the FiveM community, combining secure payments, protected digital content downloads, and real-time support via WebSockets.

features.title: Full E-commerce
features.description: Shopping cart, discount system, and secure payment gateway integrated with Stripe Checkout.

features.title: Secure Downloads
features.description: One-time-use temporary token system to protect digital content and prevent unauthorized redistribution.

features.title: Admin Panel
features.description: Complete management of products, categories, orders, and customer support from a single dashboard.

features.title: Real-time Support
features.description: Integrated ticket chat with instant notifications via Socket.io for seamless customer service.

features.title: Multi-language
features.description: Full support for Spanish and English via next-intl with automatic language detection.

features.title: Premium Design
features.description: Responsive interface with dark mode, smooth animations, and a high-quality user experience.

challenges.title: Secure Download System
challenges.description: Protecting digital content required implementing one-time download tokens with temporal expiration. Each token is generated after payment confirmation, stored in the database, and automatically invalidated after first use, preventing unauthorized redistribution.

challenges.title: WebSockets in a Serverless Environment
challenges.description: Maintaining persistent Socket.io connections on a serverless platform like Vercel was the biggest challenge. The solution was migrating to Pusher as a managed WebSocket provider, enabling real-time notifications without a dedicated server.

rutafacil.title: RutaFácil
rutafacil.description: PWA for delivery couriers: capture locations from WhatsApp and generate the shortest delivery route right on the device.

problem.description: Independent delivery couriers receive dozens of orders daily via WhatsApp or messaging apps. Manually planning the sequence of stops leads to significant fuel and time waste, while commercial routing tools require expensive subscriptions or heavy APIs.
painPoints: Wasted fuel and delivery time from estimating stop sequences manually.
High friction when copying and pasting addresses between chat apps and navigation tools.
Expensive routing subscriptions and API fees that are unviable for independent couriers and local stores.
Fragile internet connectivity on the road requiring offline-first capabilities.

solution.description: I designed and engineered RutaFácil, an ultra-fast mobile-first PWA with $0 infrastructure cost. It empowers delivery riders to share addresses directly from WhatsApp to their system Share menu, optimizing delivery sequences locally via heuristic algorithms.

features.title: On-Device TSP Optimization
features.description: Nearest Neighbor heuristic combined with 2-opt local search running in milliseconds on-device, minimizing travel distance without server dependencies.

features.title: Web Share Target Integration
features.description: Leverages the Web Share Target API to receive location links directly from WhatsApp, Google Maps, or Waze in two taps.

features.title: Offline-First PWA
features.description: Installable as a standalone app on mobile devices with local state persistence via Zustand, working reliably in low-connectivity areas.

features.title: Zero-Cost Vector Maps
features.description: Powered by MapLibre GL and Esri World Street Map tiles, delivering smooth vector mapping without recurring commercial API keys.

features.title: Turn-by-Turn Delivery Workflow
features.description: Stop-by-stop guidance with instant Google Maps/Waze launching and one-tap delivery completion.

features.title: Cash Collection & Dispatch Tools
features.description: Track cash-on-delivery payments per stop, generate WhatsApp dispatch notifications, and export route traces to GPX.

challenges.title: Zero-Cost On-Device TSP Optimization
challenges.description: Solving the Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) without paying for Google Directions or cloud matrix APIs required implementing a client-side solution combining a Nearest Neighbor greedy baseline with 2-opt segment reversals on Haversine distances. It computes near-optimal routes for up to 30 stops in under 5ms right on the courier's phone.

challenges.title: Multi-Format Location Parsing & Share Target
challenges.description: Couriers receive locations in wildly varied formats: shortened Google Maps URLs, raw coordinate pairs, Waze links, or copied chat transcripts. Built a resilient regex parser capable of scanning full multi-line conversations and extracting every stop in one pass.

problems.title: Do any of these sound familiar?
problems.sub: Every project starts with a problem in your business, not with a technology. Tap one to see how it turns into revenue or savings.

items.q: Are you losing appointments and time managing bookings over WhatsApp and phone calls?
items.how: Your customers book and pay online at any hour. You get fewer empty slots, fewer no-shows, and you get paid before the service. You stop answering messages just to sort out the calendar.
items.build: Online booking system with built-in payments

items.q: Are you selling less because you have no online store, or yours doesn't convert?
items.how: A store that sells while you sleep: secure payment, automatic delivery or download of the product, and customer support in the same place. Each sale is processed on its own, without you stepping in.
items.build: Online store and marketplace with secure payments

items.q: Is your team losing hours coordinating tasks across spreadsheets and chats?
items.how: All the work, who is doing it and by when, on a single board. Fewer meetings to ask where things stand, fewer mistakes and more on-time deliveries, which is what your client ends up paying for.
items.build: Custom task and team management tool

items.q: Do your deliveries or visits cost too much time and fuel?
items.how: A phone app orders the stops and calculates the shortest route. You make more deliveries per day with the same vehicle and spend less on fuel.
items.build: Mobile route app that runs from the browser, with no server costs

items.q: Do you repeat tasks by hand, like logging orders, sending notices or preparing reports?
items.how: I automate those tasks so they run on their own: an order that arrives by message gets logged, the customer is notified and stock is updated without anyone typing. The hours you save become hours you can bill.
items.build: Custom automations and bots for your business

items.q: Is your website slow, outdated, or not bringing you customers from Google?
items.how: A fast, well-structured website loads instantly, looks right on mobile and is easy to find for people searching for exactly what you sell. More visits that end in an inquiry.
items.build: Fast professional website optimized for search engines
